description: Quote an exact-in swap through two routers side by side: Kairo (kairo.market, ubi.fun's routing partner) and Uniswap, the routes of the ubi.fun /swap page. Any two Arc tokens with a pool: tokenIn and tokenOut each take a 0x address or one of the symbols USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI (get_swap_tokens lists their addresses); ubi.fun coins and other tokens by address (get_coins finds ubi.fun coins). amount is in tokenIn's units. Answers each router's output (routes), the one route=best picks (the higher output, Uniswap on a tie), and the minimum output at slippageBps (default 100). Kairo's routes for a pair nobody has asked for yet take a few seconds to find; this waits up to about 20 s, and kairoPending=true means ask again shortly. On some routes Kairo takes its fee (0.2% of the input, paid to Kairo); quoted outputs are after it. For a ubi.fun coin, quote_swap and prepare_swap trade on the coin's own pool and pay your referrer; these routes pay no referrer and carry no note.

amount.description: The exact input in tokenIn units (for example "100" or "0.5")

route.description: best (default): the higher output, Uniswap on a tie; kairo or uniswap: that router only

slippageBps.description: How far below the quote the minimum output may be, in basis points (100 = 1%), 1 to 5000; default 100

swapper.description: The wallet that would swap; leave unset for a price check

tokenIn.description: A 0x address, or one of USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI

tokenOut.description: A 0x address, or one of USDC, EURC, WETH, cirBTC, KAIRO, UBI

name: quote_token_swap
